responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module provides the gm2 frontend’s minimal foreign-type bridge for C character-pointer style address types. It imports SYSTEM.ADDRESS and exports CharStar and ConstCharStar as opaque address aliases, giving Modula-2-side code a stable way to declare interfaces that pass C string or pointer parameters without introducing any GCC tree-building, type-lowering, or runtime logic of its own.
